name: svg-french-press-deepseek-v4.1-flash-s1-r4
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"
     viewBox="0 0 880 1320" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="metal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#7f868d"/>
      <stop offset="0.12" stop-color="#dfe4e8"/>
      <stop offset="0.35" stop-color="#f7f9fa"/>
      <stop offset="0.52" stop-color="#c6cdd3"/>
      <stop offset="0.74" stop-color="#eef1f3"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7f868d"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="metalDark" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#6b7177"/>
      <stop offset="0.35" stop-color="#c2c8cd"/>
      <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#9aa1a7"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#6b7177"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="glass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#a9c6d6" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
      <stop offset="0.12" stop-color="#eaf3f8" stop-opacity="0.35"/>
      <stop offset="0.30" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.18"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#dceaf2" stop-opacity="0.30"/>
      <stop offset="0.80" stop-color="#c2d7e3" stop-opacity="0.42"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#8fb0c4" stop-opacity="0.65"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="mesh" width="9" height="9" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect width="9" height="9" fill="#e6d9bc"/>
      <path d="M0 0H9M0 4.5H9M0 0V9M4.5 0V9" stroke="#ae9868" stroke-width="0.9"/>
    </pattern>
    <pattern id="holes" width="15" height="15" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <circle cx="7.5" cy="7.5" r="2.3" fill="#6b7177"/>
    </pattern>
    <clipPath id="carafeClip">
      <path d="M180,870 L180,1128 Q180,1150 202,1150 L398,1150 Q420,1150 420,1128 L420,870 Z"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="880" height="1320" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="60" y="58" font-size="30" font-weight="bold" fill="#233142">French Press — Exploded Assembly</text>
  <text x="60" y="84" font-size="15" fill="#6b7885">Parts shown in order of disassembly along the plunger axis</text>
  <line x1="60" y1="96" x2="820" y2="96" stroke="#c9d2da" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Central alignment axis (drawn behind the parts) -->
  <line x1="300" y1="150" x2="300" y2="1265" stroke="#b7c0c8" stroke-width="1.6"
        stroke-dasharray="7 7"/>

  <!-- ============ 1. PLUNGER KNOB ============ -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="210" rx="36" ry="10" fill="url(#metalDark)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M264,210 L264,186 A36,10 0 0 0 336,186 L336,210 Z"
          fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="186" rx="30" ry="8.5" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M270,186 C270,156 300,150 300,150 C300,150 330,156 330,186 Z"
          fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M281,178 C283,161 292,156 300,155" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-opacity="0.7" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 2. PLUNGER ROD ============ -->
  <g>
    <rect x="293" y="250" width="14" height="120" rx="7"
          fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="300" y1="256" x2="300" y2="364" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-opacity="0.65" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- threaded end -->
    <rect x="290" y="358" width="20" height="14" rx="3" fill="url(#metalDark)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 3. LID ============ -->
  <g>
    <!-- rim band -->
    <path d="M176,430 L176,455 A124,18 0 0 0 424,455 L424,430 Z"
          fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="430" rx="124" ry="18" fill="url(#metalDark)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="430" rx="108" ry="14" fill="#e9edf0" stroke="#aab2b9" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <!-- dome -->
    <path d="M200,430 C205,398 245,382 300,382 C355,382 395,398 400,430 Z"
          fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M214,424 C220,402 250,391 288,389" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-opacity="0.65" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- center boss with rod hole -->
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="383" rx="34" ry="11" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="381" rx="9" ry="4.5" fill="#3a3f45" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 4. LOCKING NUT ============ -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="278,502 322,502 340,520 322,538 278,538 260,520"
             fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="283,508 317,508 330,520 317,532 283,532 270,520"
             fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-opacity="0.5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="520" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#3a3f45" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 5. UPPER FILTER PLATE ============ -->
  <g>
    <path d="M238,585 L238,595 A62,14 0 0 0 362,595 L362,585 Z"
          fill="url(#metalDark)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="585" rx="62" ry="14" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="585" rx="62" ry="14" fill="url(#holes)" opacity="0.55"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="585" rx="62" ry="14" fill="none" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="585" rx="11" ry="4" fill="#eef1f3" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 6. FILTER SPRING ============ -->
  <g stroke="#6f767d" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="640" rx="55" ry="9"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="652" rx="55" ry="9"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="664" rx="55" ry="9"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="676" rx="55" ry="9"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="688" rx="55" ry="9"/>
    <path d="M245,640 Q238,646 245,652" stroke="#c3c9ce" stroke-width="3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 7. MESH SCREEN ============ -->
  <g>
    <path d="M242,725 L242,733 A58,13 0 0 0 358,733 L358,725 Z"
          fill="url(#metalDark)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="725" rx="58" ry="13" fill="url(#mesh)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="725" rx="58" ry="13" fill="none" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 8. LOWER FILTER PLATE ============ -->
  <g>
    <path d="M238,785 L238,795 A62,14 0 0 0 362,795 L362,785 Z"
          fill="url(#metalDark)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="785" rx="62" ry="14" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="785" rx="62" ry="14" fill="url(#holes)" opacity="0.55"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="785" rx="62" ry="14" fill="none" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 9. GLASS CARAFE ============ -->
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <path d="M180,870 L180,1128 Q180,1150 202,1150 L398,1150 Q420,1150 420,1128 L420,870 Z"
          fill="url(#glass)" stroke="#6b7c8a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <!-- glass highlights clipped to body -->
    <g clip-path="url(#carafeClip)">
      <rect x="203" y="880" width="15" height="262" rx="7" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.45"/>
      <rect x="228" y="880" width="6" height="262" rx="3" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.30"/>
      <rect x="392" y="880" width="16" height="262" fill="#7fa2b8" opacity="0.28"/>
    </g>
    <!-- graduation ticks -->
    <g stroke="#6b7c8a" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.75">
      <line x1="196" y1="960" x2="224" y2="960"/>
      <line x1="196" y1="1010" x2="224" y2="1010"/>
      <line x1="196" y1="1060" x2="224" y2="1060"/>
      <line x1="196" y1="1110" x2="224" y2="1110"/>
    </g>
    <!-- rim band -->
    <path d="M176,848 L176,870 A124,18 0 0 0 424,870 L424,848 Z"
          fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#6b7c8a" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="848" rx="124" ry="18" fill="url(#glass)" stroke="#6b7c8a" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <!-- pouring spout -->
    <path d="M177,845 C154,842 139,834 130,822 C150,820 171,827 190,838
             L190,856 C183,858 179,857 176,854 Z"
          fill="url(#glass)" stroke="#6b7c8a" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- handle -->
    <path d="M418,905 C505,912 512,1000 502,1055 C494,1096 458,1120 420,1120
             C460,1106 480,1078 486,1046 C495,998 486,930 418,942 Z"
          fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2.2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="1266" rx="152" ry="15" fill="#dfe4e8" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- ============ 10. BASE / STAND ============ -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="1180" rx="136" ry="20" fill="url(#metalDark)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="1180" rx="106" ry="14" fill="#565c62" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <path d="M164,1180 L164,1240 A136,20 0 0 0 436,1240 L436,1180 Z"
          fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="200" y1="1184" x2="200" y2="1242" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-opacity="0.55" stroke-width="5"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="1240" rx="136" ry="20" fill="url(#metalDark)" stroke="#5b6167" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ NUMBER BADGES + LEADER LINES ============ -->
  <g stroke="#9aa4ad" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-dasharray="5 5">
    <line x1="158" y1="196" x2="262" y2="196"/>
    <line x1="158" y1="310" x2="291" y2="310"/>
    <line x1="158" y1="443" x2="176" y2="443"/>
    <line x1="158" y1="520" x2="258" y2="520"/>
    <line x1="158" y1="585" x2="236" y2="585"/>
    <line x1="158" y1="640" x2="243" y2="640"/>
    <line x1="158" y1="725" x2="240" y2="725"/>
    <line x1="158" y1="785" x2="236" y2="785"/>
    <line x1="158" y1="1000" x2="178" y2="1000"/>
    <line x1="158" y1="1210" x2="162" y2="1210"/>
  </g>
  <g font-size="15" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">
    <g fill="#2c3e50">
      <circle cx="140" cy="196" r="15"/><circle cx="140" cy="310" r="15"/>
      <circle cx="140" cy="443" r="15"/><circle cx="140" cy="520" r="15"/>
      <circle cx="140" cy="585" r="15"/><circle cx="140" cy="640" r="15"/>
      <circle cx="140" cy="725" r="15"/><circle cx="140" cy="785" r="15"/>
      <circle cx="140" cy="1000" r="15"/><circle cx="140" cy="1210" r="15"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="#ffffff">
      <text x="140" y="201">1</text><text x="140" y="315">2</text>
      <text x="140" y="448">3</text><text x="140" y="525">4</text>
      <text x="140" y="590">5</text><text x="140" y="645">6</text>
      <text x="140" y="730">7</text><text x="140" y="790">8</text>
      <text x="140" y="1005">9</text><text x="140" y="1215">10</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ LEGEND ============ -->
  <g>
    <rect x="560" y="420" width="288" height="400" rx="14" fill="#f6f8fa" stroke="#d4dbe2" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="584" y="454" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#233142">Parts list</text>
    <line x1="584" y1="466" x2="824" y2="466" stroke="#d4dbe2" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  </g>
  <g font-size="15.5" fill="#33414f">
    <!-- each row: badge + text -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="590" cy="492" r="12" fill="#2c3e50"/><text x="590" y="497" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
      <text x="612" y="497">Plunger knob</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="590" cy="524" r="12" fill="#2c3e50"/><text x="590" y="529" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
      <text x="612" y="529">Plunger rod</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="590" cy="556" r="12" fill="#2c3e50"/><text x="590" y="561" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
      <text x="612" y="561">Lid</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="590" cy="588" r="12" fill="#2c3e50"/><text x="590" y="593" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
      <text x="612" y="593">Locking nut</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="590" cy="620" r="12" fill="#2c3e50"/><text x="590" y="625" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
      <text x="612" y="625">Upper filter plate</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="590" cy="652" r="12" fill="#2c3e50"/><text x="590" y="657" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">6</text>
      <text x="612" y="657">Filter spring</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="590" cy="684" r="12" fill="#2c3e50"/><text x="590" y="689" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">7</text>
      <text x="612" y="689">Mesh screen</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="590" cy="716" r="12" fill="#2c3e50"/><text x="590" y="721" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">8</text>
      <text x="612" y="721">Lower filter plate</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="590" cy="748" r="12" fill="#2c3e50"/><text x="590" y="753" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">9</text>
      <text x="612" y="753">Glass carafe</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="590" cy="780" r="12" fill="#2c3e50"/><text x="590" y="785" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">10</text>
      <text x="612" y="785">Base / stand</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
